name: Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension
definition: The **Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension** is the least worst-case sample size in a recursive teaching sequence when every teaching sample is required to use only positive examples of its target concept.
graph_summary: Recursive teaching dimension with positive-only teaching samples.
origin_references: The positive recursive variant is defined in \cite{fallat2023batch}.

monotonic.proof: Take a positive recursive teaching order for the original class and retain only the targets of a subfamily. Each retained positive teaching set still separates its target from every later retained target, so the largest teaching-set size cannot increase.

c_monotonic.proof: Restrict a positive recursive teaching order to the conditioned fibre and delete fixed coordinates from its positive teaching sets.
